restaurantName: Xing Fu Yi Zhan (Yulei Third Street)
address: 8 Yulei Third Street, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Furnished like a vintage staging post, this restaurant whisks you back in time. Feel free to join the servers and dress up in period costume for a selfie. The Sichuanese head chef feeds hungry patrons with Chongqing-style cooking characterised by rich, intense flavours. Stir-fried dried pork with smoked bamboo shoot packs serious wok hei and a hint of smokiness. On the shelves, local liquors are on display, including some brewed in-house....
pageTitle: Xing Fu Yi Zhan (Yulei Third Street)
